svg.title: Academic genealogy of the Predictive Fluid and Aeroscience Lab
svg.desc: Doctoral advisor lineage from Johann Bernoulli and Abraham Gotthelf Kaestner through Felix Klein, Arnold Sommerfeld, John A. Wheeler, Kip S. Thorne, William H. Press and Philip S. Marcus to Sangjoon Lee, and on to the students of the lab. Each arrow points from an advisor to a student.
